witness.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to ride a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter upon the sidewalks on Fremont Street between Main Street and Seventh Street.
witness.reason: A paved road with an activating sidewalk can realize the specified location without changing its fixed geometry.
required_context: Establish covered device classification and riding status.
Establish riding rather than walking the device and a covered device classification with its applicable requirements and exclusions.
Establish sidewalk boundaries and an ego riding route on the sidewalk.
Establish the sidewalk's boundaries, pedestrian purpose and location on Fremont Street between Main Street and Seventh Street; retain the geographic assumption pending map evidence.
Preserve unresolved municipal applicability of supplied NRS definitions and the legal consequence of absent or deficient signs.
Record required area signs and their coverage.
Retain area-sign content, locations and coverage for all three categories, separately from the riding prohibition and without attributing the posting obligation to the rider.
Verify the paved road and adjacent sidewalk are within the specified Fremont Street extent.
witness.subject_reason: The available operator can ride one of the three named categories; walking the device would not establish this conduct.
